sources.scope: Direction-dependent positive lambda interval for Minkowski perturbations of the ball, not arbitrary endpoint body.
Global three-dimensional pessimal packing problem distinguished from local results.

registry_checks: Palomar Ulam matches are Kuratowski-Ulam topology; Hexagon Ulam floating-body problem; OpenAI Ulam stability group-theory results. No matching packing metadata. Focused arXiv, primary author/publisher, Zenodo, HAL and GitHub searches.
scope_comparison: Target includes all convex solids under arbitrary O(3) congruences, no symmetry/near-sphere condition. Local directional/lattice results do not establish global lower density pi/sqrt18. Reinhardt planar packing and random protocols are different objectives.
rationale: Bounded searches found no full matching resolution or announcement; primary local theorem does not extend to all shapes.
